source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Read out the **war zone rules** that your Location card gives for that phase; they apply to this battle.

If both players attempt Agendas, set aside your mission deck’s Primary Missions:

1. Reveal Force Disposition cards.
2. On the current Briefing card of your Alliance, use the chart to match your Force Disposition against your opponent’s.
3. The resulting Agenda card names your Primary Mission for this battle.

If either player declines Agendas, each player looks up the opponent’s disposition symbol on their own card; the Primary Mission under it sets how they earn VP. Only players who declined earn VP from it; a player attempting an Agenda takes their Agenda card’s Primary Mission instead.

Either way, the two Force Disposition cards set the layout.

anyDeclines.lookup: opponent symbol on own Force Disposition card
